requirements.text: The library management system shall ensure that no member can borrow more than 5 books simultaneously.
The library management system shall automatically track and notify members of overdue books via digital notifications within 24 hours of the due date.
The library management system shall maintain real-time inventory status of all books to prevent double borrowing.
The library management system shall provide a backup mechanism to recover all transaction data in case of a failure.
The library management system shall implement a user authentication process to ensure only registered members can access borrowing features.
The library management system shall log all transactions, including borrow and return actions, for audit purposes.
The library management system shall enable searching for books with a response time of under 2 seconds for 95% of queries.
The library management system shall allow up to 5 simultaneous book borrow operations per member to optimize resource utilization.
The library management system shall track book availability and update the status in real-time to ensure accurate information.
The library management system shall process book returns within 1 second to maintain high throughput.
The library management system shall maintain an uptime of 99.5% to ensure consistent availability for users.
The library management system shall ensure compliance with data protection regulations by implementing encryption for all member data.
The library management system shall provide an accessible interface for all users, including those with disabilities.
The library management system shall implement a feedback mechanism for members to report issues or suggestions regarding fairness in library services.
The library management system shall provide an energy usage report for library operations at least quarterly.
The library management system shall implement a recycling program for damaged books, ensuring proper disposal.
The library management system shall track the total energy savings achieved through digital operations compared to traditional methods.
The library management system shall prioritize the acquisition of e-books to reduce physical resource consumption.
